name: Cat Facts
tagline: Simple public API for random cat facts and breed data
description: Cat Facts (catfact.ninja) is a free public REST API that returns random cat facts and a list of cat breeds. It is commonly used as a hello-world API for learning HTTP clients, teaching demos, and lightweight novelty features. No authentication is required for the documented endpoints.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public endpoints accept unauthenticated GET requests.

example.response_snippet: {"fact":"Cats have five toes on their front paws, but only four toes on their back paws.","length":78}

use_cases: fetch a random cat fact for a demo or tutorial
test HTTP client libraries with a live public endpoint
populate placeholder content in a fun pet-themed UI
verify JSON parsing in integration smoke tests
